## Triage: first grade — `documentation` · `tooling` · `priority:p2` · `domain:devx` · `area:devpath` · `needs-user-decision` · `pm:awaiting-maintainer` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-26T12:05Z

⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. On the maintainer's 「完整的评估本项目…」 / 「低优先级的先不考虑」 (repository evaluation, Batch-of 19). Low priorities were excluded at filing, so the execution cards grade p2.

- **A decision card:** the options and the filer's recommendation are in the body, and the letter is the maintainer's. These are ui-merge leftovers, adjacent to the epic's #25712 (same directories). Whatever the letter, the execution waits for #25712's PR 2.

Pointer from the README / brand evaluation the maintainer asked for on 2026-10-26 (「评估 objectstack readme该如何改进」, 「objectui 是否建议去掉」, then 「同意，派卡处理」) · written 2026-10-26T13:07Z · `session_01FMuBZmssbfQkVrKRtxNvng`. ⛔ Not a claim, not a ruling.

Item ① `ui/README.md` is more than a nested duplicate of a top-level doc: it is still Object UI's **product** README, so it carries a second brand inside this repository. Read at `main` 679fc7ce:

- Title line "The Universal Schema-Driven UI Engine"; a `license-MIT` badge and a CI badge that points at the archived repository's workflow (`objectstack-ai/objectui/workflows/CI`), which will never run again.
- A `Documentation | Quick Start | Examples | Changelog | Roadmap` nav pointing at `ui/ROADMAP.md` / `ui/CHANGELOG.md` (the same files this card lists).
- A three-product narrative — `Describe → ObjectStack / Render → Object UI / Operate → ObjectOS` — that the organisation profile and the root README no longer use (two brands, not three).
- 5 links back to `github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui` (archived; `grep -c 'github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui' ui/README.md` → 5).

Whatever letter is ruled, the UI text that survives should read as a **workspace** README rather than a product one: first sentence along the lines of "`ui/` is the view layer of ObjectStack: a schema-driven React renderer, usable on its own through `@object-ui/*`"; keep the Quick Start table, the package table and the screenshots; drop the badge row and the three-product block; links go to `ui/…` paths, not to the archived repo. `@object-ui/*` package names and the objectui.org docs site (`ui/apps/site`) stay — they name a package and a site, not a brand.

This supports **A** for item ①. The root README itself is a separate maintainer-directed card (slimming + three stale lines), filed today by this session; the organisation profile and pinned repositories are the maintainer's own action.

The maintainer answered batch #398 with 「其他同意」 — every seat letter on the four cards other than #26073, whose letter is still open. Brief 6417246253. Letter **A**: fold the six `ui/` top-level documents into their root equivalents (`README`, `ROADMAP`, `CONTRIBUTING`, `QUICK_REFERENCE`; `ui/CHANGELOG.md` kept as frozen history or moved under releases; `ui/LICENSE` and `ui/LICENSE-THIRD-PARTY.md` stay — the ui packages are MIT); delete `ui/.claude/hooks/*` (never loaded; the root hooks guard every repository path per their headers); register `ui/docs/adr/` in the root index under a `ui-` prefix without renaming files (Prime Directive 13), riding #26076's index PR; delete `ui/.github/dependabot.yml` (GitHub reads only the root file), `ui/lychee.toml` and `ui/turbo.objectui.json` after `scripts/ui-import/README.md`, their only reader on `origin/main`, is updated. Not B (two CONTRIBUTINGs and two ROADMAPs would remain) and not C.

Serialization: after #25712's PR 2 lands (it owns `ui/AGENTS.md` and the nested workflows); the dispatching seat re-reads #25712's PR file lists first.

**The card thread's read-only premise reading, at `origin/main` `5ec398dc`. Start here, because two of the ruling's conditions do not hold as written:**
- `scripts/ui-import/README.md` no longer exists; it was retired with its splice tool in #25753 (`pnpm-workspace.yaml:713`). It is not "their only reader".
- `ui/turbo.objectui.json` is live input. `ui/scripts/workspace-root.mjs` reads it (`PARKED_TURBO_CONFIG` / `uiTurboConfigPath()`), and so do 8 `ui/scripts` tests (check-dist-completeness, e2e-type-check, helpers/turbo-inputs, select-type-check-scope, turbo-build-outputs-cover-published-entries, turbo-lint-inputs, turbo-task-guard-coverage, workspace-root.test). Deleting it turns Test UI red.
- `ui/lychee.toml` is read by `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-links-workflow.test.ts`. The ruling said delete only after confirming nothing reads them, so both stay. Whether those tests should read the scoped root `turbo.json` instead is a follow-up card.
- The four docs are pinned: `ui/scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` `SCAN_ROOTS` has a row for each, and `check-doc-links.test.ts` pins them; `quick-reference-commands-4149.test.ts` reads `ui/QUICK_REFERENCE.md`; `markdown-test-inputs.mjs` records it. Four tests read the `ui/README.md` fences (Basic Usage, Kanban Board): page-body-single-node-8310, page-body-arity-8310, readme-kanban-example-8256 and object-calendar-container-by-reference-6152. `check:doc-types` reads its json fences too.
- **The thread's proposed route:**
  - The root README gains a short "ObjectUI (`ui/`)" section.
  - The pinned code examples move to `ui/content/docs/guide/quick-start.md`, so the pins retarget inside `ui/`.
  - QUICK_REFERENCE's cheat sheet becomes a "UI workspace" section of root CONTRIBUTING, with the 4149 pin retargeted.
  - The four `SCAN_ROOTS` rows are dropped.
  - Relative links in `ui/apps/console/README.md` and `ui/.changeset/README.md` are repointed.

Still open on the card beyond slice 1: the `ui/.claude/hooks` deletion (governed), and the `ui/docs/adr` index prefix (rides #26076).
